name: widget_title
label: Widget Title
hint: The title displayed at the top of the Help Center Topics widget

name: heading_level
label: Heading Level
hint: The heading level to use for the widget title

name: topic_card_display_style
label: Topic Card Display Style
hint: Compact default for more than 2 topics, Detailed default for 2 topics, Quick actions are only recommended for single topics.

name: card_limit
label: Card Limit
hint: Sets the number of topics to display.

name: topic_card_content_limit
label: Topic Card Content Limit
hint: Sets the number of content links to display for Detailed Topic card display style.

name: load_config
label: Load Configuration
hint: Determines whether to load widget data synchronously or asynchronously
